sourceConflict: The exact Dutch annual study product marks third year as the outgoing curriculum for entrants through 2024. The archive confirms the staged revision from 2025. The 2026–2027 OER arts. 3.1–3.2 confirm a programme-level 150/30 split; footnote 19 distinguishes the outgoing 15 EC open space. Its thesis references do not give a current revised third-year course ledger or project progression. The current product returns the same annual record even under later year queries. The 24 exact 5 EC module records substantiate the 120 EC displayed. The annual first-year Law Practices, language test and tutor listings carry zero additional credit. The archived outgoing thesis and courses do not establish the revised year.
unresolved: Leiden confirms the first two years of the revised curriculum. The third-year listing is for students who started in 2024 or earlier. The revised third-year courses, elective rules and thesis requirements still need confirmation.
